apexActivation.samplingCaveat: Flags describe ONLY the last accepted return at a saved instant, not all20500+ substeps/events. Exported trial-volume increment is current minus committed and may be0 after each loadstep commit; use differences of accumulated totals across saved frames to observe interval volume change. Positive accumulated plastic volume is strain, not geometrical particle volume, porosity or exact multiplicative Fp determinant.

localization.meaning: Paper plastic tensor invariant and concentration, not damage or proof of a throughgoing slip surface

reaction.interpretation: Reaction is native total strip actuator response per unit thickness; completion/colour/apex activation alone does not imply peak failure or landslide
